assembly.title: x86-64 Assembly
assembly.description: Learn x86-64 assembly — the language of the machine. Understand registers, the stack, calling conventions, and how high-level code maps to hardware.

aws.title: AWS (LocalStack)
aws.description: Core AWS services from first principles to production patterns — S3, IAM, DynamoDB, Lambda, SQS/SNS, API Gateway — practiced locally against LocalStack.

buildkite.title: Buildkite
buildkite.description: Buildkite pipelines from first steps to production CI/CD — agents, artifacts, conditionals, matrices, plugins, and dynamic pipelines.

c.title: C Foundations
c.description: Learn C — the language closest to the machine. Understand memory, pointers, and systems programming from first principles.

cpp.title: Modern C++
cpp.description: Learn C++ with a modern mindset — RAII, smart pointers, templates, and the STL. Write expressive, efficient, safe C++.

dsa-java.title: DSA Patterns: Java
dsa-java.description: Master the 16 core algorithmic patterns that appear in nearly every technical interview — implemented in Java. Two pointers, sliding window, BFS/DFS, dynamic programming, backtracking, and more.

dsa-javascript.title: DSA Patterns: JavaScript
dsa-javascript.description: Master the 16 core algorithmic patterns that appear in nearly every technical interview — implemented in JavaScript. Two pointers, sliding window, BFS/DFS, dynamic programming, backtracking, and more.

dsa-python.title: DSA Patterns: Python
dsa-python.description: Master the 16 core algorithmic patterns that appear in nearly every technical interview — implemented in Python. Two pointers, sliding window, BFS/DFS, dynamic programming, backtracking, and more.

dsa-typescript.title: DSA Patterns: TypeScript
dsa-typescript.description: Master the 16 core algorithmic patterns that appear in nearly every technical interview — implemented in TypeScript with full type annotations. Two pointers, sliding window, BFS/DFS, dynamic programming, backtracking, and more.

elixir.title: Elixir Essentials
elixir.description: Learn Elixir — a functional, concurrent language built on the Erlang VM. Master pattern matching, processes, OTP, and fault-tolerant system design.

go.title: Go Fundamentals
go.description: Learn Go from first principles — syntax, types, concurrency, and the standard library — culminating in a real CRUD API capstone project.

helm.title: Helm
helm.description: Learn Helm — the Kubernetes package manager. Write reusable, parameterized charts that deploy complex applications reliably across environments.

java.title: Java Essentials
java.description: Learn Java — a statically typed, object-oriented language built for large-scale systems. Master classes, interfaces, generics, and the streams API.

javascript.title: JavaScript Fundamentals
javascript.description: Master modern JavaScript — the language of the web. Learn the syntax, idioms, and async patterns every JS engineer uses daily.

kafka.title: Kafka
kafka.description: Apache Kafka from first principles to production — partitions, delivery semantics, replication, and the configuration patterns behind reliable event streaming.

kotlin.title: Kotlin Essentials
kotlin.description: Learn Kotlin — a modern, concise JVM language with null safety, coroutines, and a powerful type system. The primary language for Android and a great Java alternative.

kubernetes.title: Kubernetes
kubernetes.description: Learn Kubernetes from first principles to production patterns — pods to autoscaling, written for app developers deploying real services.

observability.title: Observability
observability.description: Metrics, dashboards, alerts, and traces with Prometheus, Grafana, and OpenTelemetry — what to measure, how to capture it, and how to graph what matters.

python.title: Python Essentials
python.description: Learn Python — the language of data science, scripting, and rapid prototyping. Master Pythonic idioms, the standard library, and async patterns.

ruby.title: Ruby Essentials
ruby.description: Learn Ruby — an expressive, object-oriented language built for developer happiness. Master blocks, modules, metaprogramming, and Ruby's elegant standard library.

rust.title: Rust Essentials
rust.description: Learn Rust — a systems language with memory safety without garbage collection. Master ownership, borrowing, lifetimes, and fearless concurrency.

shell.title: Shell Scripting
shell.description: Master Bash scripting — the glue of every Unix system. Write robust scripts for automation, text processing, and system administration.

terraform.title: Terraform
terraform.description: Learn Terraform — the infrastructure-as-code standard. Define, plan, and provision cloud infrastructure with HCL across any provider.

typescript.title: TypeScript Essentials
typescript.description: Add static types to JavaScript. Learn TypeScript's type system, generics, and tooling to write safer, more maintainable code.
